description: One unit's closure: .factory/cycles/<cycle>/units/<workflow>[.<subject>].json (record closure). Tracked. Every writer goes through vsdd.state.cycles.closure_update, which owns the read-modify-write and the validation; the stage entries keep the order the stages finished in. Cap 16,000 bytes. A later version may add a field, at the top level or inside stages, verdict or delivery: read records that carry an unknown field, never refuse them (decision D33).

schema.description: The record form; closure_update starts records at 1.

workflow.description: The workflow the unit belongs to: spec, plan, wave, story, verify, ingest, import, maintain.

subject.description: The unit id (W-02, S-7.03); empty for a whole-workflow unit such as spec or verify.

cycle.description: The cycle the record sits in; _standing for work outside a product cycle.

state.description: How far the unit has got; open when the record is created.

stages.description: Stage entries in the order the stages finished, which is what lets revise clear from the review stage onward without a list of stages.

verdict.description: The convergence verdict (topic verdicts) as vsdd.state.verdicts.summary computes it: perimeter, head, patch_id, passes, rounds_used, outcome, and the counts of advisory, dismissed and waived findings.

head.description: The commit the last pass reviewed; empty when nothing was reviewed.

patch_id.description: The git patch-id of the diff from delivery.base to head; empty when it cannot be computed.

rounds_used.description: The loop-1 total across runs, never below the stored one (decision D13).

outcome.description: converged, review_stale, pending and the other outcomes of topic verdicts.

delivery.description: What vsdd story deliver and the admission wrote: the state the delivery reached and the facts the evidence lookup reads back.

state.description: merged, awaiting_merge, ci_failed, conflict, review_stale, refused, checkout_dirty; empty before delivery.

detail.description: What failed, for the repair step.

needs_person.description: protected_path, dependency or configured when delivery stopped for a person; empty otherwise.

run.description: The run that delivered or admitted the unit.

at.description: ISO 8601 UTC, whole seconds, ending Z.

head.description: The commit the delivery or the admission measured.

patch_id.description: The git patch-id of the subject's diff from delivery.base to head at that moment.

base.description: The commit the story branch was cut from; admission sets it, and delivery re-records it after a rebase.

branch.description: The branch the story is delivered to: the target branch (require_story's 'target'), not the story branch; admission records it, and delivery re-records it after a rebase.

baseline.description: A plain object until G7 shapes the ingest and import baseline records (plan decision D3).

waves.description: The plan closure only: the map from wave to stories that vsdd plan schedule computed.

flaky.description: The identities of inherited tests a gate recorded as flaky, copied from the gate's evidence by the command that writes this record.

admitted_by.description: How the story became ready: plan, or the run that admitted it through vsdd gate plan --story or vsdd story new-fix.
